title: Cloudflare Tunnel Connector Restart Burst
app: OpenWrt, UniFi, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS over HTTPS resolvers, and scheduled probes via syslog, APIs, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cloudflared:connector
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(event="restart")) as restarts by connector _time
| where restarts>2
| sort - restarts
description: Uses Cloudflare Tunnel connector logs telemetry to monitor daily connector restart bursts in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for tunnels that are unstable enough to impact exposure, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Cloudflare Tunnel connector logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It totals daily connector restart bursts so you can spot tunnels that are unstable enough to impact exposure before it becomes annoying.
